title: Edgecom design tokens
description: The compiled token model. src/app/globals.css remains the authority; this is the structured view of it, generated by scripts/gen-tokens.mjs and validated in CI so the two cannot disagree.

version.description: Git tag the model was built at, or 'untagged'.

digest.description: The identity of the whole design system — sha256 over the tokens, the design language, the primitives and the authored overlays, 16 hex chars — computed once in scripts/lib/system.mjs and stamped into every published artifact and into the design bundle's _system.json, so a design or an app built against a different digest is working from a different system. It changes when the system changes, not when a commit happens, so a committed copy stays parity-clean.

family.description: Semantic role. 'legacy' is the migration-only palette; 'relative-surface' are alpha-over-host tokens with no absolute value.

dark.description: null means .dark does not override it, so the light value carries.

modeIndependent.description: Same value in both themes — either no dark entry, or the same value restated. The brand blue relies on this.

restatedInDark.description: Deliberately repeated in .dark with an identical value, to make mode-independence visible at the source.

aliasOf.description: The token this one points at via var(), if any.

tailwindUtility.description: Whether @theme inline maps it, i.e. whether a Tailwind utility can reach it. Deliberately false for the whole legacy family.

then.description: The legacy palette has no --color-* mapping on purpose, so no utility can reach it from a class. That guardrail is mechanical, not advisory.
